messages:
maya: ran the cross‑region kernel sweep this morning, posting the short/long sequence split and perf notes. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
liam: nice — did you test q4/q8 quantized builds or FP16 only?
maya: both. baseline FP16, q8 and q4_0 for Llama2-13B. small load: seq=64 batch=4. big load: seq=2048 batch=1.
andre: can you drop numbers? even rough p50/p99 + tokens/sec is enough.
maya: sure — pasted microbench output below (truncated):
```
# us-west (h100) - FlashAttn v3
seq=64 b=4: p50=6.2ms p99=14.8ms tokens/s=48k
seq=2048 b=1: p50=18.5ms p99=54.2ms tokens/s=9.1k
# eu-west (a100) - Triton vendor kernel
seq=64 b=4: p50=8.3ms p99=26.1ms tokens/s=41k
seq=2048 b=1: p50=26.7ms p99=110.3ms tokens/s=6.8k
# quantized (q8) on h100
seq=2048 b=1: p50=21.9ms p99=63.5ms tokens/s=8.1k
```
liam: interesting delta on p99 for long seq on a100 — vendor kernel p99 ballooned. did you try hybrid (flash for short, triton for long)?
maya: yes. routing rule: if seq<=256 -> FlashAttn v3 else Triton. net: p99 improves overall 20% on tail for us-west, 12% in eu-west.
sre-jen: what about failure modes? does hybrid trigger any KV cache incompatibilities?
maya: no incompatibilities seen. We normalized KV key layout. main issue is slightly higher jitter when switching kernels mid-session; we added 50ms hysteresis.
andre: cost note? switching to q4 reduced tokens/s by ~10% but cut GPU mem usage allowing 2% more density. worth it for low-cost tiers.
liam: any regressor tests for quality after q4?
maya: ran 1k eval prompts, BLEU-ish style diffs: mean delta ~0.6% (statistically insignificant for chat style). will run larger evals if we promote.
ops-bot: deploy-batch: kernel-selector v0.3 rolled to canary in us-west. Status: 3/3 pods healthy. :white_check_mark:
liam: suggested policy for rollout doc:
- keep FlashAttn v3 default for all H100 instances.
- use Triton vendor for A100 for seq>512 by default.
- enable q4 for Dedicated low-cost pool after eval gating.
- implement per-request kernel hint header (x-req-pref: latency|throughput) so product can favor latency or yield.
- add routing hysteresis: 50ms p99 buffer before failover.
maya: added draft PR with routing rules + microbench artifacts: https://git.internal/repo/infra/kernel-selector/pull/42
andre: I'll run a capacity sizing sim with new rules and share numbers tomorrow.
sre-jen: add alert if hybrid routing flips >10x/min in a node — indicates oscillation.
liam: +1. also capture per-token cost delta in logs (est cost cents/token) so we can automatically prefer cheaper variant at scale.
maya: thanks all — next step: extended eval (10k prompts) and then canary to eu-west.
liam: :rocket:
